bundle_classes.synthetic_meaning: A bundle whose members are bundles. It is not a deployment unit of its own: deployment resolution expands it to its members and continues to count functional classes.

pillars.meaning: Bundle family in the four-pillar reading of the system: memory keeps and finds state, control steers it, uas serves the person directly, domain carries subject matter. The pillar groups bundles for reading and composing; it is not a second class and takes no part in deployment resolution.
pillars.field: optional top-level 'pillar' on a bundle manifest
pillars.class_relation: class says what kind of unit a bundle is (functional or selection register); pillar says which family it belongs to. Both are independent.

hosted_and_cross_pillar.ellmos-multitenancy-bundle: hosted-private class is orthogonal to the four pillars

role_pair_model.statement: Two component pairs the user described as one multi-select are modelled as complementary role pairs, not as choice groups: task-master with ticket-master (tasks.default and the new tickets.capture) and USMC with GARDENER (memory.curated and memory.organic). Each role keeps minimum 0 and maximum 1, so 'both, one or neither' follows from how many roles a deployment fills.
role_pair_model.not_done: No cross-role choice group, no role merge, no change to an existing role's cardinality. The range pick value stays available and unused until a role genuinely needs maximum above one.
